fields.title: Liberia e-GP tender record
fields.description: One record per row/tender. Shape depends on recordType: TENDER_CURRENT / TENDER_OPENED / TENDER_AWARDED (one per listing mode=list can produce) or TENDER_DETAIL (mode=detail, a raw dt/dd key-value passthrough of the tender's own detail page -- field set varies by procurement type, so extra fields beyond those listed below may appear). A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a page/tender fails or is inaccessible.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: For list records: 'list:<listType>'. For detail records: the resourceId or URL that was requested.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-current-listing, S1-opened-listing, S1-awarded-listing, S1-detail, or 'none' on error).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed records (blocked_or_transient, not_found_or_restricted).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_page.title: Page
_page.description: Which page of the listing (10 rows/page) this row came from. mode=list only.

_totalAvailable.title: Total available
_totalAvailable.description: Total rows the platform reports for this listing, before any maxResults truncation. mode=list only.

resourceId.title: Resource ID
resourceId.description: The e-GP platform's internal numeric tender ID.

tenderUrl.title: Tender URL
tenderUrl.description: Link to the tender's full detail page on the e-GP platform.

title.title: Tender title
title.description: The tender's title/name. On TENDER_CURRENT rows this comes from a column upstream mislabels 'Process No' -- it holds the title, not a reference number (verified against the raw HTML).

procuringEntity.title: Procuring entity
procuringEntity.description: The government body running this procurement.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short description (TENDER_CURRENT rows only, from the listing's info tooltip; TENDER_DETAIL rows have their own separate 'description' field from the detail page).

bidsSubmissionDeadline.title: Bids submission deadline
bidsSubmissionDeadline.description: TENDER_CURRENT / TENDER_OPENED only. Platform's own date format (dd/mm/yyyy HH:MM:SS).

procedure.title: Procedure
procedure.description: TENDER_CURRENT only -- procurement procedure (e.g. National Open Competitive Bidding).

status.title: Status
status.description: TENDER_CURRENT / TENDER_OPENED only -- e.g. Bid Submission, Evaluation.

noticePdfUrl.title: Notice PDF URL
noticePdfUrl.description: TENDER_CURRENT / TENDER_AWARDED only -- link to the official notice PDF, when published.

procurementMethod.title: Procurement method
procurementMethod.description: TENDER_OPENED only -- e.g. Restricted Bidding (RB), Request for Quotations (QT).

openedBidsUrl.title: Opened bids URL
openedBidsUrl.description: TENDER_OPENED only -- link to the opened-bids detail view.

openedBidsLabel.title: Opened bids label
openedBidsLabel.description: TENDER_OPENED only -- link text, usually 'View Opened Bids'.

awardAmount.title: Award amount
awardAmount.description: TENDER_AWARDED only -- raw text as shown upstream, e.g. '4518.00 (USD)'.

packageNumberCode.title: Package number code
packageNumberCode.description: TENDER_AWARDED only -- the procuring entity's own tender/package reference number.

grantOrLoanNumber.title: Grant or loan number
grantOrLoanNumber.description: TENDER_AWARDED only -- present when the contract was funded by a donor grant/loan.

lotName.title: Lot name
lotName.description: TENDER_AWARDED only -- raw text, 'N/A' when the contract wasn't split into lots, or a region/county list for multi-lot contracts.

nameOfProcuringEntityUrl.title: Procuring entity URL
nameOfProcuringEntityUrl.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- link to the procuring entity's organisation profile page.

currentStatus.title: Current status
currentStatus.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- e.g. 'Process at bidding stage'.

resourceIdFromDetailPage.title: Resource ID (as shown on detail page)
resourceIdFromDetailPage.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- the detail page's own 'Resource ID:' field (e.g. 'procurement-250740'), renamed from 'resourceId' to avoid colliding with this actor's own numeric resourceId field.

procurementType.title: Procurement type
procurementType.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- e.g. Goods, Works, Non Consultancy Services.

procurementEstimateAmount.title: Procurement estimate amount
procurementEstimateAmount.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- raw text, currency given separately.

bidSecurityAmount.title: Bid security amount
bidSecurityAmount.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- present only when a bid security is required for this tender.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across all record types -- rows missing a given column render blank.
